_comments: Train ML Model — thin Action boundary over TrainingEngine.trainModel.
Type='Custom' + DriverClass binds to the @RegisterClass(BaseAction,'PredictiveStudioTrainModelAction') class.
The action validates PipelineID, refuses the retired MaxRows input by name, delegates to the engine (production seams), and maps the run's stored gate decision onto the outputs.
MaxRows is retired: the Prediction Unit decides the rows and every eligible row is read. Its param row is deleted (deleteRecord).

fields.Name: Train ML Model
fields.Description: Trains a predictive model from an ML Training Pipeline under the pipeline's Prediction Unit and Evaluation Protocol: freezes a Training Snapshot, carves the locked holdout by date, selects on inner folds, fits the baselines and stores the three-outcome gate decision with its reason on the training run. Outputs the run's gate outcome and reason, the snapshot and protocol, the model id (none under no-signal), the test-set scores and whether one feature dominates the predictions (possible target leakage).

fields.Name: PipelineID
fields.Description: Id of the MJ: ML Training Pipelines row to train.

fields.Name: MaxRows
fields.Description: Retired. Training reads every eligible row the Prediction Unit resolves; a supplied MaxRows is refused by name.

fields.Name: ModelID
fields.Description: Id of the produced (Draft) MJ: ML Models row; null when the stored gate decision ships no model (no-signal, or the existing rule kept).

fields.Name: HoldoutMetrics
fields.Description: JSON of the test-set scores measured once on the locked holdout: the produced model's stored scores when a model exists, otherwise the trainer's finalist scores.

fields.Name: LeakageFlagged
fields.Description: True when one feature dominates the model's predictions (possible target leakage). A flagged model stays Draft and needs human sign-off before promotion.

fields.Name: GateOutcome
fields.Description: The gate's stored outcome: model, keep-simple-baseline or no-signal.

fields.Name: GateReason
fields.Description: The stored reason for the gate outcome, generated from the stored comparisons.

fields.Name: TrainingSnapshotID
fields.Description: The MJ: ML Training Snapshots row the run trained on.

fields.Name: EvaluationProtocolID
fields.Description: The MJ: ML Evaluation Protocols row (exact version) the run was evaluated under.
The training run completed; GateOutcome and GateReason say whether a model was produced (ModelID is null when none was).
PipelineID is missing.
The training engine failed (pipeline not found, sidecar error, or a save failure), or a retired input (MaxRows) was supplied.

Training refused: a read would return fewer rows than are in scope, so the model would be trained on a fraction of its scope; training reads every row of the target entity. The same code the PredictiveStudio.TrainModel operation returns.

Training refused: the as-of setting asks for point-in-time assembly that training cannot perform, so the model would be identical to Mode 'none'. The same code the PredictiveStudio.TrainModel operation returns.

Training refused: the pipeline's ValidationStrategy.MajorityBaselineRule is not a known value ('enforce' or 'warn'). Fix or remove it (removing it uses 'enforce') and train again. The same code the PredictiveStudio.TrainModel operation returns.

_comments: Score Record Set — thin Action boundary over ScoringService.
With a BindingID it scores through the binding and writes the binding's Feature Values (Score);
without one the model predicts and nothing is written (Predict). Outputs the scoring run's fields.

fields.Name: Score Record Set
fields.Description: Scores a set of records with a trained ML Model. The scope selects records (explicit ids / a saved view / a list / an entity+filter / a single record). With a BindingID the binding's pipeline's Published model scores the scope and the scores are written as the binding's Feature Values (and copied into its column, when it names one); without one the model predicts and the predictions are returned, writing nothing, for a scope of at most 250 records (a larger one is refused with READ_CAP_EXCEEDED before scoring). Outputs the scoring run: ScoringRunID, Status, Total, Written, Failed, and Predictions when nothing was written. A refused or failed run fails the action with the refusal's code and still names its scoring run.

fields.Name: ModelID
fields.Description: Id of the MJ: ML Models row to score with.

fields.Name: Scope
fields.Description: JSON describing the records to score. Populate exactly one of: records (id/pk array), viewId, listId, filter ({entityName, extraFilter, maxRows}), single ({entityName, primaryKey}). A filter's maxRows is a guard: a scope matching more rows is refused (READ_CAP_EXCEEDED), never sampled.

fields.Name: WriteBack
fields.Description: Retired. Score Record Set writes only through a scoring binding (BindingID); there is no write-back directive.

fields.Name: ScoredCount
fields.Description: Retired. See Total and Written.

fields.Name: WroteBack
fields.Description: Retired. See Written.

fields.Name: BindingID
fields.Description: Optional. The scoring binding to score through: its pipeline's Published model scores the scope, and the scores are written as the binding's Feature Values (and copied into its column, when it names one). ModelID must name that model (a call naming another version is refused INVALID_INPUT). Without it, the predictions are returned and nothing is written.

fields.Name: AsOfDate
fields.Description: Optional. The date the scope is scored as of (ISO); the run date when omitted. Only a model trained on a Prediction Unit scores an earlier date.

fields.Name: ScoringRunID
fields.Description: The MJ: ML Scoring Runs row of the call; set on a refused or failed run too.

fields.Name: Status
fields.Description: The scoring run's status: completed, refused or failed.

fields.Name: Total
fields.Description: Records in the scope.

fields.Name: Written
fields.Description: Feature Values written (0 without a BindingID and on a dry run).

fields.Name: Failed
fields.Description: Records that failed (a failed run).

fields.Name: Predictions
fields.Description: JSON array of predictions ({recordId, score, class, adverseProbability, inTraining}), each keyed by the record's bare key; present when nothing was written (no BindingID, or a dry run). A call without a BindingID returns at most 250 (a larger scope is refused before scoring).
Records scored: written as the binding's Feature Values, or the predictions returned (no binding).
ModelID is missing, or Scope is missing/empty/populates no selector.
Scope resolution or the scoring run failed (model/artifact not found, sidecar error).

Scoring refused: an explicit row cap would cut the scope short, or a call without a BindingID names more than 250 records (its predictions would be returned inline). The same code the PredictiveStudio.ScoreRecordSet operation returns for a capped scope.
Scoring refused by a Record Process no binding names: the model's status does not allow scoring (only Published scores). Score Record Set reports a model's status as MODEL_NOT_PUBLISHED.
The model does not exist or has no trained artifact yet. A binding run over a never-trained model ends a failed run (SCORING_RUN_FAILED).
Scoring refused: the model's status is not Published (the refusal names the status). The run row records the refusal.
Scoring refused: the model carries leakage flags, or a dominance re-run flagged one feature.
Scoring refused: the model's artifact file is missing.
Scoring refused: the model's artifact bytes do not match its registered SHA-256.
Scoring refused: the model has no registered artifact hash to verify against.
Scoring refused: the assembled feature columns do not match the model's schema; the message names the missing, extra and retyped columns.
Scoring refused: the scope's entity is not the model's or the binding's entity, and no entity mapping was given.
Scoring refused: feature assembly refused the scope (a capped read, a row its change history does not cover).
Scoring refused: a feature column holds no value on any scored record.
Scoring refused: the binding's pipeline has no Published model.
Scoring refused: the scoring binding was withdrawn.
Scoring refused: the caller does not hold the binding's view authorization.
Scoring refused: a model trained without a Prediction Unit scores only the run date.
Scoring refused: a pre-change model kept serving has no stored feature importance to test for leakage.
Scoring refused: the caller may not create and update MJ: Feature Values, so a run that writes them is refused before any read (a dry run is not).
The scoring run stopped at a batch in which a record failed; the batches before it stay. ScoringRunID names the run and its first errors.

The input breaks the action's contract (a BindingID whose pipeline is not the model's, a ModelID that is not the model the binding scores with, an unknown entity or key, a non-UUID id); the message names the field.

_comments: Run Experiment Session — thin Action boundary over ExperimentOrchestrator.runSession.
Validates that an APPROVED PlanSpec is supplied, parses Budget + ExperimentID, delegates, maps the result.

fields.Name: Run Experiment Session
fields.Description: Disabled: experiment sessions are switched off; returns EXPERIMENT_SESSIONS_UNAVAILABLE. Executes an approved modeling plan as an experiment session — running its proposed experiments in waves to completion or until the budget bound, maintaining a leaderboard. Outputs the session id, the best (winning) model id, the final leaderboard, and why the session stopped.

fields.Name: PlanSpec
fields.Description: The approved modeling plan (ModelingPlanSpec JSON) to execute. Must have Approved=true — execution is gated on user approval.

fields.Name: ExperimentID
fields.Description: Optional id of an existing MJ: Experiments definition to attach the session to. When omitted, a new durable Experiment is created from the plan.

fields.Name: Budget
fields.Description: Optional budget override ({ MaxRuns, MaxComputeCost, MaxWallclockMinutes }). When omitted, the plan's ProposedBudget is used.

fields.Name: SessionID
fields.Description: Id of the MJ: Experiment Sessions row that was executed.

fields.Name: BestModelID
fields.Description: Id of the best (winning) model produced, or null when no iteration produced one.

fields.Name: Leaderboard
fields.Description: JSON of the final leaderboard, best-first ({ IterationID, Metric, ModelID }).

fields.Name: StopReason
fields.Description: Why the session stopped: completed, or a clean budget pause (budget-maxRuns / budget-maxComputeCost / budget-maxWallclock).
Experiment session ran to completion or paused cleanly on the budget.
PlanSpec is missing or not a valid modeling plan.
The PlanSpec is not approved (Approved is not true) — execution is gated on user approval.
The orchestrator failed during execution.
Experiment sessions are switched off; the action refuses before reading any parameter. The same code the PredictiveStudio.StartExperimentSession operation returns.

_comments: Promote ML Model — thin Action boundary over the Predictive Studio lifecycle gate (LifecycleGate).
Takes one Transition (evaluate, publish, archive, rollback); a leakage-flagged model is withheld until a person records a sign-off.
Lifecycle-only — never edits metrics, only Status.

fields.Name: Promote ML Model
fields.Description: Applies one lifecycle Transition to an ML Model through the Predictive Studio lifecycle gate: evaluate (Draft to Validated or KeepBaseline from the training run's stored gate decision), publish (Validated or KeepBaseline to Published, re-verified from the stored rows), archive (to Archived, Reason required) or rollback (Archived to Published for a model published before, Reason required). A model whose training run flagged possible target leakage is withheld until a person records a sign-off in the model detail. Lifecycle-only: never edits the model's metrics or artifact, only its Status.

fields.Name: ModelID
fields.Description: Id of the MJ: ML Models row to transition.

fields.Name: TargetStatus
fields.Description: Retired. The action takes a Transition.

fields.Name: SignOff
fields.Description: Retired. A leakage flag is acknowledged only by a sign-off record a person makes in the model detail.

fields.Name: Transition
fields.Description: The lifecycle transition to apply: evaluate, publish, archive or rollback.

fields.Name: Reason
fields.Description: Why the transition is made: required for archive and rollback, recorded with a publish.

fields.Name: Status
fields.Description: The model's new lifecycle status, on success.
The lifecycle gate applied the transition; the Status output is the model's new status.
ModelID is missing, or Transition is missing or not one of evaluate, publish, archive, rollback.
Retired. A flagged model is refused with LEAKAGE_FLAGGED.
No ML Model exists with the provided ModelID.
Retired. The action no longer saves the model; the lifecycle gate does.
The lifecycle gate threw (a lost connection, a lock or save failure); the message carries the error.
Retired. A missing reason is refused with REASON_REQUIRED.
The lifecycle gate refused calibration-held: the model's holdout calibration slope is outside 0.8-1.2 or could not be measured, so it cannot be validated or published (no sign-off overrides this).
The lifecycle gate refused not-servable: the model has no artifact file, its artifact is a series forecaster /predict does not serve yet, or its stored rows cannot be evaluated.
The lifecycle gate refused unacknowledged-leakage-flags: the training run's leakage audit flagged the model, and it is published only after a person records a sign-off naming each flag.
The lifecycle table has no move from the model's status to the one the transition asks for (for example, publishing a Draft model).
An archive or a rollback was asked for without a Reason.

The lifecycle gate refused the transition for another reason (it does not beat the published model, the artifact cannot be verified, another publish holds the lock, and so on); the message names the refusal kind.

_comments: Schedule Model Scoring — thin Action boundary over the PS2-6 CreateScheduledModelScoring helper.
Schedules a trained ML Model to score a record scope on a recurring cadence. OutputField is OPTIONAL:
set it to write the prediction into that column (+ a scoring binding); omit for generic output (predictions
in the process run history only). Validates ModelID + TargetEntityName + exactly one scope selector,
delegates to the helper (which creates + saves a scheduled MJ: Record Processes row whose owned
MJ: Scheduled Jobs row is auto-created on save), and returns the new Record Process id + cron.

fields.Name: Schedule Model Scoring
fields.Description: Binds a trained ML Model to write its prediction into a target entity column on a recurring schedule (e.g. monthly). Creates a scheduled Record Process that scores the rows selected by a filter and writes the prediction back into the chosen column on its cadence. Outputs the new Record Process id and the cron expression.

fields.Name: ModelID
fields.Description: Id of the MJ: ML Models row to score with.

fields.Name: TargetEntityName
fields.Description: Name of the entity whose rows are scored and written (e.g. 'Memberships').

fields.Name: OutputField
fields.Description: Optional. The target-entity column to write the prediction into (e.g. 'RenewalScore'). Omit for generic output — each run records its predictions in the process run history (MJ: Process Run Details) only, with no write-back column and no scoring binding.

fields.Name: ScopeFilter
fields.Description: SQL predicate over the target entity selecting which rows each scheduled run scores (e.g. "Status='Active'").

fields.Name: Cadence
fields.Description: Recurrence: 'Monthly' (default — 1st of each month), 'Weekly', 'Daily', or a raw cron expression. When omitted, Monthly is used.

fields.Name: PrimaryKeyField
fields.Description: Primary-key field on the target entity (defaults to 'ID').

fields.Name: ValueKind
fields.Description: Which prediction value to write: 'score' (numeric probability/value — the default) or 'class' (predicted class label).

fields.Name: RecordProcessID
fields.Description: Id of the scheduled MJ: Record Processes row that was created (its owned MJ: Scheduled Jobs row is auto-created on save).

fields.Name: CronExpression
fields.Description: The cron expression the scoring run recurs on.
The scheduled scoring Record Process was created and saved (now live on its cadence).
A required param (ModelID / TargetEntityName / ContextUser) or the single scope selector is missing (OutputField is optional — omit for generic output).
The target entity was unknown, or the Record Process failed to save.

_comments: Migrate Pipelines to Prediction Units and Evaluation Protocols — the Prediction Unit data migration, run by the release step (dry run by default, idempotent). It holds two kinds of pipeline: one whose adverse class is not declared (a re-run migrates it once declared) and one that declares a time index (held until a forecast unit with a rolling-origin protocol is bound).
Type='Custom' + DriverClass binds to @RegisterClass(BaseAction,'PredictiveStudioMigratePipelinesAction').

fields.Name: Migrate Pipelines to Prediction Units and Evaluation Protocols
fields.Description: Gives every ML Training Pipeline that lacks one a version-1 Prediction Unit (from TargetEntity, TargetVariable, ProblemType and AsOfStrategy) and a version-1 Evaluation Protocol (from ValidationStrategy and LeakageGuard: the trailing holdout fraction becomes a date cutoff, k-fold becomes repeated inner folds, the deny lists become exclusions), and binds both. Pipelines that cannot be expressed (offset as-of, a single-valued target, sequence models) are archived with the reason in their description; two kinds of pipeline are held (kept as is, no unit or protocol written, training refused, reason in the description): a binary pipeline whose adverse class its OutcomeConfig, newest model or target name does not declare, until a later run migrates it; and a pipeline that declares a time index (ValidationStrategy.TimeIndexColumn), which needs a forecast unit with a rolling-origin protocol rather than a seeded-random holdout. Dry run by default; skips pipelines already bound. Outputs a per-pipeline report.

fields.Name: DryRun
fields.Description: true (default) reports what would be created, archived or held without saving.

fields.Name: PipelineIDs
fields.Description: Optional subset of MJ: ML Training Pipelines ids; all pipelines when omitted.

fields.Name: Report
fields.Description: JSON array, one row per pipeline: action (migrated, would-migrate, archived, would-archive, held, would-hold, skipped, failed), reason, unit and protocol ids, cutoff, notes.

fields.Name: MigratedCount
fields.Description: Pipelines migrated (or that a dry run would migrate).

fields.Name: ArchivedCount
fields.Description: Pipelines archived (or that a dry run would archive) because they have no Prediction Unit form.

fields.Name: HeldCount
fields.Description: Pipelines held (or that a dry run would hold): an undeclared adverse class (migrated by a later run once declared) or a declared time index (held until a forecast unit with a rolling-origin protocol is bound). Training them is refused.

fields.Name: SkippedCount
fields.Description: Pipelines skipped (already bound to a unit and a protocol, or already archived).

fields.Name: FailedCount
fields.Description: Pipelines whose migration failed; the report names the reason.
